name: Repay Holdings Corporation
summary: Repay Holdings Corporation, a payments technology company, provides integrated payment processing solutions that enables consumers and businesses to make payments using electronic payment methods in the United States. It operates through two segments: Consumer Payments and Business Payments. The company offers payment acceptance solutions, such as debit and credit card processing, automated clearing house (ACH) processing, e-cash, and digital wallet services; virtual credit card processing, enhanced ACH processing, instant funding, clearing and settlement, and communication solutions; and proprietary payment channels that include Web-based, mobile application, text-to-pay, interactive voice …
